description: A mild viral infection of the nose and throat.
self_care: Rest; drink warm fluids; use steam inhalation
see_doctor_if: Symptoms last more than 10 days or you have trouble breathing

description: A viral infection (flu) with fever and body ache.
self_care: Rest; drink plenty of fluids; eat light food
see_doctor_if: Fever lasts more than 3 days or you feel breathless or confused

description: An allergic reaction causing sneezing and a runny nose.
self_care: Avoid dust and pollen; keep windows closed; wash bedding often
see_doctor_if: Symptoms are severe or you have wheezing

description: A strong recurring headache often with light sensitivity and nausea.
self_care: Rest in a dark quiet room; drink water; avoid known triggers
see_doctor_if: Sudden very severe headache or headache with weakness or vision loss

description: Stomach acid flowing back up causing heartburn.
self_care: Eat smaller meals; avoid spicy and oily food; do not lie down right after eating
see_doctor_if: Chest pain; trouble swallowing; or symptoms lasting more than 2 weeks

description: A stomach infection causing vomiting and loose motions.
self_care: Drink fluids and ORS; eat light food; rest
see_doctor_if: Blood in stool; high fever; or signs of dehydration

description: Pain or irritation in the throat.
self_care: Gargle warm salt water; drink warm fluids; rest your voice
see_doctor_if: Pain lasts more than a week or you cannot swallow

description: Overstretched or torn muscle causing pain and stiffness.
self_care: Rest; apply ice then warmth; do gentle stretching
see_doctor_if: Severe swelling; or you cannot move the area

description: A skin infection causing itchy red rashes.
self_care: Keep skin clean and dry; wear loose cotton clothes; do not share towels
see_doctor_if: Rash spreads quickly or does not improve in 2 weeks

description: Difficulty passing stools or infrequent motions.
self_care: Eat more fibre; drink more water; stay active
see_doctor_if: Severe stomach pain; blood in stool; or lasts more than 3 weeks
